question: How is the nine-syllabled great knowledge-mantra positioned in relation to the kāma-seed?
premises: There is a nine-syllabled great knowledge-mantra.
This mantra is situated above the kāma-seed.
inference: The nine-syllabled great knowledge-mantra is established above the kāma-seed.
plain_english: The nine-syllabled great knowledge-mantra is situated above the kāma-seed.
